blocks.en:
Illuminant estimation is a fundamental problem in computational photography, as it enables the correction of color shifts induced by varying lighting conditions. While learning-based methods have demonstrated strong performance, their progress is hindered by the limited availability of large-scale datasets with accurate illuminant ground-truth. In this work, we propose a general and reusable pipeline to derive dense illuminant chromaticity maps from physically based 3D-rendered scenes. By repurposing an existing 3D scene collection, our approach enables the systematic generation of pixel-wise illuminant annotations under controlled lighting conditions, effectively lowering the barrier to data acquisition for learning-based illuminant estimation. Using this pipeline, we generate a large-scale synthetic set of 74,321 images, which we employ for pre-training both single- and multi-illuminant estimation models.
Extensive experiments with state-of-the-art architectures show that synthetic pre-training consistently improves performance, with gains of up to 28% for single-illuminant estimation and up to 57% for multi-illuminant estimation, particularly in data-scarce regimes. These findings demonstrate that synthetic data generation pipelines offer an effective and scalable solution for the pre-training of illuminant estimation methods.
blocks.zh:
光辉估计是计算摄影中的一个基本问题,因为它能够校正由不同照明条件所引发的颜色相变. 虽然以学习为基础的方法表现出了良好的业绩,但由于具有准确明了的地面真实性的大规模数据集有限,其进展受到阻碍。 在这项工作中,我们提出一个通用和可再利用的管道,从基于物理的3D的场景中取出密集的光亮色相图. 通过重新使用现有的三维场景收集,我们的方法能够在受控照明条件下系统生成像素明智的照明说明,有效地降低基于学习的照明估计获得数据的障碍。 利用这一管道,我们生成一套由74,321个图像组成的大规模合成图象,我们使用这些图象进行单发和多发光体预培训。
对最先进的建筑进行的广泛实验表明,合成预训不断提高性能,单发光子估计的收益可达28%,多发光子估计的收益可达57%,特别是在数据稀缺制度中。 这些调查结果表明,合成数据生成管道为照明性估计方法的预先训练提供了有效和可扩展的解决办法。

blocks.en:
Illuminant estimation is a key component of modern digital imaging pipelines, as it compensates for color shifts caused by varying illumination conditions. By estimating the chromaticity of the scene’s light sources, illuminant estimation enables color correction that aligns image appearance with human perception of white and neutral tones under different lighting. Beyond photographic enhancement, accurate illuminant estimation is essential for many computer vision tasks, including object recognition, scene understanding, and image retrieval, where color consistency directly affects downstream performance [ 6 ] .
Early approaches relied on global statistical assumptions about the color distribution of natural images [ 22 ] . While computationally efficient, such methods often fail under complex or spatially varying illumination. Learning-based models, including convolutional neural networks [ 3 , 12 , 1 ] and more recent transformer-based architectures [ 14 ] , significantly improve robustness by leveraging contextual and semantic information. However, their effectiveness is constrained by the limited availability of large-scale datasets with accurate illuminant ground-truth, whose acquisition requires controlled capture conditions and reference measurements.
This limitation is especially pronounced for multi-illuminant estimation, where illumination varies spatially across the scene and pixel-level annotations are required.
To address this challenge, we leverage physically based 3D-rendered scenes as a principled source of dense illuminant supervision. Photorealistic renderings provide explicit access to reflectance and illumination properties of the scenes, enabling the derivation of accurate per-pixel illuminant chromaticity, information that is prohibitively difficult to obtain at scale from real images.
In this work, we introduce a general and reusable methodology for extracting dense illuminant chromaticity maps from physically based 3D renderings. The proposed pipeline exploits the illumination–reflectance decomposition available in modern rendering engines to generate physically grounded per-pixel supervision, suitable for pre-training both single- and multi-illuminant estimation models and independent of network architecture.
As a concrete instantiation of the proposed methodology, we apply the pipeline to the Hypersim dataset [ 18 ] to generate a large synthetic corpus for pre-training. Importantly, we emphasize that this instantiation serves as a proof of scalability rather than a dataset-specific contribution: the methodology itself is readily transferable to other rendering environments and synthetic scene collections. Extensive experiments with state-of-the-art architectures [ 19 , 9 , 12 ] and standard benchmark datasets [ 13 , 2 , 11 ] demonstrate consistent performance improvements across architectures and illuminant estimation settings.
blocks.zh:
光线估计是现代数字成像管的一个关键组成部分,因为它补偿了由不同光线条件所引发的颜色变化. 通过估计场景光源的相色度,明亮的估计可以使色彩校正,使图像外观与不同照明下人类对白色和中性色调的感知相配合. 除了增强相片外,准确的光亮估计对于许多计算机视觉任务至关重要,包括物体识别,场景理解和图像回取,而色彩一致性会直接影响下游的性能 [6].
早期的方法依赖于关于自然图像颜色分布的全球统计假设[22]. 虽然计算效率很高,但在复杂或空间相差不一的照明下,这类方法往往会失败。 以学习为主的模型,包括进化神经网络[3,12,1]和更近代的变压器为主的架构[14],通过利用上下文和语义信息,大大提高了稳健性. 然而,由于具备准确的明亮地貌的大型数据集的有限可用性,其有效性受到制约,而获取这些数据集需要有控制的捕获条件和参考测量。
对于多发光体估计来说,这一限制特别明显,因为整个场景的发光空间不同,需要像素级的说明。
为了应对这一挑战,我们利用基于实体的3D-投降场景,作为密集的明亮监督的原则来源。 相片现实性渲染为场景的反射和发光特性提供了明确的取用途径,使得每个像素的光亮色度都能够产生准确性,而从真实图像中获取这种信息在规模上极为困难。
在这项工作中,我们采用了一种一般的可再用的方法,从物理上基于3D的渲染中取出密集的光亮色相图. 拟议的管道利用现代渲染引擎中可用的照明-反光分解来产生物理上固定的每像素监督,适合进行单发和多发光估计模型的预训练,独立于网络结构。
作为拟议方法的具体即时说明,我们把管道应用到Hypersim数据集[18],生成一个用于预训的大型合成体. 重要的是,我们强调,这种即时处理是可伸缩性的证明,而不是特定数据集的贡献:这种方法本身很容易被转用于其他渲染环境和合成场景收集。 有关最新建筑[19、9、12]和标准基准数据集[13、2、11]的广泛实验表明,在各种建筑和明亮的估算设置方面,业绩不断改善。

blocks.en:
Existing approaches for illuminant estimation can be broadly categorized into traditional statistics-based methods and learning-based techniques, and further distinguished by whether they assume a single global illuminant or spatially varying (multi-illuminant) illumination. Early methods typically assume a single dominant illuminant affecting the entire scene. Classical algorithms such as Gray World, White Patch, Shades of Gray, and Grey Edge [ 22 ] rely on global statistical assumptions about the color distribution of natural images. While computationally efficient, these approaches often fail in complex scenes with spatially non-uniform lighting or multiple light sources.
Learning-based methods have significantly advanced illuminant estimation by leveraging data-driven representations. CNN-based models, such as those proposed by Bianco et al. [ 3 ] and the FC 4 model by Hu et al. [ 12 ] , directly regress illuminant chromaticity from image content and substantially outperform traditional techniques in single-illuminant settings. To handle more realistic scenarios with spatially varying illumination, recent work has focused on dense or local estimation. Encoder–decoder architectures, including UNet [ 19 ] , predict pixel-wise or region-wise illuminant maps [ 13 ] , while models such as HDRNet [ 9 ] apply locally adaptive color transformations guided by learned illumination representations. More recently, transformer-based architectures [ 14 ] have further improved performance by capturing long-range spatial dependencies and contextual cues. Despite these advances, learning-based methods remain heavily dependent on large, accurately annotated datasets, which are challenging to acquire in real-world settings.
blocks.zh:
现有照明估计方法可被广泛分为传统的以统计为基础的方法和以学习为基础的技术,并被进一步区分为它们是否承担单一的全球照明剂或空间差异(多照明剂)照明剂。 早期方法通常假设一个单一的主导照明剂影响整个场景. Gray World,White Patch,Shades of Gray等古典算法和Grey Edge [22] 依赖于关于自然图像颜色分布的全球统计假设. 虽然计算效率高,但这些方法往往在空间不统一照明或多光源的复杂场景中失败.
以学习为基础的方法通过利用由数据驱动的表述方式,大大地推动了具有启发性的估算。 基于CNN的模型,例如由Bianco等人提出的模型. [3] (中文(简体) ). FC 4模型由胡等所出. [12],直接从图像内容中退后光亮的相色度,并在单发光度环境中大大地超过传统技术. 为了处理空间相差悬殊的照明情况,最近的工作侧重于密集或局部的估计。 Encoder–decoder架构,包括UNet [19],预测以像素为方向或以区域为方向的明亮地图 [13],而HDRNet [9]等模型则应用了以所学到的照明表示为导向的局部适应性色彩转变. 最近,基于变压器的架构[14]通过捕捉远程空间依赖性和上下文提示,进一步提高了性能. 尽管取得了这些进展,以学习为基础的方法仍然严重依赖大量、准确附加说明的数据集,这些数据集在现实世界环境中难以获得。

blocks.en:
Research in illuminant estimation has historically relied on a limited number of real-world datasets. Widely used benchmarks such as ColorChecker [ 11 ] , NUS-8 [ 4 ] , and Cube++ [ 7 ] provide images captured under controlled conditions, with illuminant annotations obtained from calibration targets. These datasets are primarily designed for single-illuminant estimation and typically provide only global illuminant annotations.
To better capture real-world lighting complexity, newer datasets such as LSMI [ 13 ] and MIMO [ 2 ] introduce scenes with multiple light sources and offer pixel-wise illuminant ground-truth. While these datasets enable the development of multi-illuminant estimation methods, their scale and diversity remain limited due to the cost and complexity of acquiring accurate annotations. Dense ground-truth illuminant maps often require specialized acquisition setups, careful calibration, or manual intervention, resulting in datasets that are relatively small and heterogeneous in annotation quality. Consequently, the scarcity of large-scale, diverse, and consistently annotated real-world datasets remains a major bottleneck for training and evaluating modern illuminant estimation models.
blocks.zh:
光辉估计的研究历来依赖数量有限的现实世界数据集. 被广泛使用的基准,如ClorChecker [11],NUS-8 [4],和Cube++ [7] 提供在被控制条件下捕获的图像,从校正目标中获取出明亮的注释. 这些数据集主要是为单发光子估计而设计的,一般只提供全球光亮说明.
为了更好地捕捉现实世界的照明复杂性,LSMI[13]和MIMO[2]等较新的数据集引入了多光源的场景,并提供了像素般的明亮地-真实. 虽然这些数据集能够开发出多发光体估计方法,但由于获得准确说明的成本和复杂性,其规模和多样性仍然有限. 密集的地上真知灼见地图往往需要专门的采集设置、仔细的校准或人工干预,导致数据集在注释质量上相对地小而多样. 因此,缺乏大规模、多样化和一贯附加说明的现实世界数据集,仍然是培训和评价现代光辉估计模型的一个主要瓶颈。
愿景任务的合成数据集

blocks.en:
Synthetic datasets have become an important resource for many computer vision tasks, including optical flow [ 16 ] , semantic segmentation [ 17 ] , and depth estimation [ 20 ] . By providing full control over scene geometry, material properties, and illumination, synthetic data enable the creation of large-scale datasets with precise ground-truth annotations at minimal cost. Prior work has shown that pre-training on synthetic data followed by fine-tuning on real-world datasets can significantly improve generalization and robustness [ 20 , 8 ] .
Advances in photorealistic rendering and physically based illumination models have further reduced the gap between synthetic and real imagery, allowing realistic simulation of complex lighting interactions and material reflectance. Despite these successes, the use of synthetic data for illuminant estimation remains limited. Early attempts relied on simplified illumination models or global color transformations [ 10 ] , which fail to capture the intricate interactions between lighting, geometry, and surface reflectance.
More recently, photorealistic 3D datasets such as Hypersim [ 18 ] and Replica [ 21 ] provide detailed geometric, material, and illumination information that can be repurposed for illuminant estimation. These datasets offer a promising foundation for pre-training and benchmarking illuminant estimation models, particularly in scenarios where annotated real-world data are scarce.
blocks.zh:
合成数据集已成为许多计算机视觉任务的重要资源,包括光学流[16],语义分解[17],和深度估计[20]. 通过全面控制场景几何,材料属性和发光,合成数据使得能够以最低的成本创建具有精确地-地-地-地说明的大型数据集. 先前的工作表明,先进行合成数据培训,再对现实世界数据集进行微调,可以显著地提高通俗化和稳健性[20,8].
光现实化渲染和以物理为基础的照明模型的进步进一步缩小了合成成像和真实成像之间的差距,从而可以现实地模拟复杂的照明相互作用和物质反射. 尽管取得了这些成功,但利用合成数据进行明度估计仍然有限。 早期的尝试依赖于简化的照明模型或全局色变[10],无法捕捉出照明,几何和地表反射之间的复杂相互作用.
更近些时候,光现实化的3D数据集如Hypersim [18]和Replica [21]提供了详细的几何,材料和发光信息,可以被重新用于光亮估计. 这些数据集为培训前和制定基准的具有启发性的估计模型提供了一个有希望的基础,特别是在缺乏附加说明的现实世界数据的情况下。

blocks.en:
Hypersim [ 18 ] is a synthetic HDR dataset comprising 77,400 photorealistic indoor images rendered from 461 distinct 3D scenes. Originally developed for geometric learning, physically based vision tasks, and multi-task scene understanding, Hypersim provides detailed geometric and photometric metadata for each scene. This rich information makes the dataset suitable for tasks beyond its original scope, including illuminant estimation.
Each rendered image in Hypersim is accompanied by multiple data modalities, including geometric attributes and a decomposition of the scene radiance into diffuse illumination and residual non-diffuse components. The diffuse illumination images are particularly relevant for illuminant estimation, as they represent scene lighting independent of surface reflectance and can serve as a reference for estimating illuminant chromaticity and constructing dense illumination maps.
blocks.zh:
Hypersim [18] 是一款合成的HDR数据集,由来自461个不同立体场景的77,400个相片现实化室内图像所出. Hypersim最初是为几何学习,基于物理的视觉任务,以及多任务场景理解而开发的. Hypersim为每个场景提供了详细的几何和光度元数据. 这种丰富的信息使得数据集适合超出其最初范围的任务,包括明亮的估算.
Hypersim中的每个渲染成的图像都伴有多种数据模式,包括几何属性和将场景光分解为扩散发光和残留的不发光组件. 散射发光图像与光照估计特别相干,因为这些图像是独立于地表反射的场景照明,可作为估算光照色度和绘制密集发光图的参考。

blocks.en:
Although Hypersim does not natively provide illuminant annotations for color constancy or illuminant estimation, its physically based rendering ensures photometric consistency between illumination, reflectance, and observed color. This allows us to derive dense ground-truth illuminant maps from the available rendering outputs. Specifically, each image is defined by three components: diffuse illumination ( L L ), diffuse reflectance ( R R ), and a residual term ( ρ \rho ) capturing specular reflections, interreflections, and other non-Lambertian effects. The final rendered image ( I I ) is reconstructed as: I = ( R ⊙ L ) + ρ . I=(R\odot L)+\rho. (1) In this work, we use the diffuse illumination component L L as a proxy for the scene illuminant. In principle, L L provides an accurate estimate of the illuminant for Lambertian surfaces. However, in practice, relying on L L alone is insufficient: in regions dominated by specular reflections, shadows, or other non-diffuse effects, the residual term ρ \rho often contributes most of the observed radiance, while L L may contain near-zero or missing values (rendered as black pixels). Direct use of L L would therefore produce incomplete or physically inconsistent illuminant maps.
To address this, we augment the diffuse illumination with the grayscale intensity of the residual term prior to normalization: L ^ = normalize ​ ( L + avg ​ ( ρ ) ) , \hat{L}=\text{normalize}\bigl(L+\text{avg}(\rho)\bigr), (2) where avg ​ ( ρ ) \text{avg}(\rho) denotes the per-pixel mean over the RGB channels of the residual image. The residual is assumed to be dominated by view-dependent reflectance and therefore provides limited reliable chromatic information. This choice is intentionally conservative with respect to chromaticity, as it avoids injecting spurious color information while preserving illumination magnitude in non-diffuse regions. The combined illumination is then normalized to obtain dense per-pixel chromaticity maps.
All images are provided in HDR format. We apply the tonemapping function released by the dataset authors, omitting the gamma correction step to preserve a linear relationship between radiance and pixel values. In cases where the diffuse illumination image contains black pixels—indicating regions where illumination is fully captured by the residual term—we assume neutral illumination and generate binary masks to exclude these pixels from the training loss.
A manual inspection is carried out to remove malformed images, resulting in a final set of 74,321 images. Figure 1 shows examples of reconstructed scenes alongside their corresponding dense illuminant chromaticity maps.
The resulting dataset, which we refer to as Hypersim-WB, is split following a per-scene strategy to avoid data leakage: 80% of the scenes are used for training, 20% for testing, with an additional 20% of the training set reserved for validation.
blocks.zh:
虽然Hypersim在本土并没有为颜色坚固或光亮估计提供亮度说明,但其基于物理的渲染确保了光亮、反射和所观察到的颜色之间的光度一致性。 这使我们能够从现有的渲染产出中获取密集的地情图。 具体地说,每个图像由三个部分来定义:放光(L L ),放光反射(R R ),以及一个能捕捉光谱反射,互射等非兰伯特效应的剩余名词(活字). 最终渲染出的形象(一一)被重建为: I= (R·Q·L) + ρ. I=(R\odot L)+\(+\). (1)在本作中,我们使用散射照明组件LL作为场景照明剂的代名词. 原则上,LL为兰伯特地表提供了闪光剂的准确估计. 然而,在实践中,仅依靠L本身是不够的:在以光谱反射为主的区域,阴影,或其他非分光效应,所剩术语 ^\rho 往往贡献了所观测到的大部分光度,而L L 可能包含近零或缺失值(还原为黑色像素). 因此,直接使用LL将产生不完整或物理上不一致的照明图。
为了解决这个问题,我们在正常化前用剩余术语的灰色强度来增加扩散光线:L^=正态化(L + avg (ρ)),\hat{L}=\text{正态izebigl (L+\text{avg} (\rho)\bigr),(2) 其中avg (ρ)\text{avg}(\rho)表示剩余图像的RGB通道上的每像素平均值. 所剩的被假定为以视差为主的反射,因此提供了有限的可靠的色相信息. 这种选择在色相方面是有意保守的,因为它避免了在非疏松地区注入虚假的色彩信息,同时保留了发光量. 然后将组合发光法正常化,以获得密集的每像素色相图.
所有图像均以人类发展报告格式提供。 我们应用了由数据集作者释放的调色图函数,省略了伽玛校正步骤,以保持光线和像素值之间的线性关系. 如果扩散的照明图像含有黑色像素——表明剩余术语充分捕捉到照明的区域——我们假定是中性照明并产生二进制口罩,将这些像素排除在训练损失之外。
进行人工检查以去除变形图像,最终形成74,321个图像. 图1显示重建场景的例子,并附有相应的密集光亮色相图.
由此形成的数据集,我们称之为Hypersim-WB,按照一地一地的策略进行分拆,以避免数据泄露:80%的场景用于培训,20%用于测试,另外20%的训练被保留用于验证.

blocks.en:
All experiments are conducted under a consistent setup to ensure fair comparisons between methods.
Our experimental protocol is designed to isolate the contribution of synthetic pre-training from architectural choices, focusing on data efficiency, robustness under limited supervision, and convergence behaviour rather than absolute peak performance. Models are first pre-trained on the Hypersim-WB dataset and subsequently fine-tuned on real-world datasets. We adopt the Adam optimizer [ 5 ] with an initial learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , scheduled via cosine annealing [ 15 ] with warm restarts every 10 epochs. During fine-tuning, early stopping is applied with a patience of 50 epochs.
For inference, test images are resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 pixels, and model outputs are resized back to the original dimensions. Training is guided by the angular error loss, masking pixels where only the residual ρ \rho contributes to the radiance. Quantitative evaluation reports the angular error distribution, including mean, best-quartile (B-25), worst-quartile (W-25), and 95th percentile (95-P) values.
blocks.zh:
所有试验都是在一个一致的设置下进行的,以确保各种方法之间的公平比较。
我们的实验协议旨在将合成预训的贡献与建筑选择隔离开来,侧重于数据效率,在有限监督下的坚固性,以及趋同行为而不是绝对的峰值性能. 模型首先在Hypersim-WB数据集上进行预训并随后在现实世界数据集上进行微调. 我们采用亚当优化器 [5] 初始学习率为 1×10 − 4 1\times 10×4 }, 计划通过相声反射 [15] , 每10个纪元恢复温暖。 在微调期间,以50个纪元的耐心实施早期停放.
对于推断,测试图像被调整为256×256\times 256像素,模型输出被调整回原尺寸. 训练以角错失为指针,遮掩像素,只有所剩的 $\rho 才能促进光线. 定量评价报告角差分布,包括平均值、最佳等分数(B-25)、最差等分数(W-25)和95%等分数(95-P)。

blocks.en:
For multi-illuminant estimation, we follow prior work [ 13 ] and evaluate two representative image-to-image architectures: UNet [ 19 ] and HDRNet [ 9 ] . Each model is trained to infer from RGB inputs the dense illuminant maps described in the Data Generation Pipeline section. For comparison, we also include the Gray World (GW) [ 22 ] algorithm and the FC 4 model [ 12 ] , representing statistical and learning-based single-illuminant methods, respectively. To evaluate these baselines, their global illuminant predictions are expanded to the size of the ground-truth dense map.
All learning-based models are initially trained on Hypersim-WB and then fine-tuned on the real-world LSMI [ 13 ] and MIMO [ 2 ] datasets. To assess the effect of pre-training, we also train models from scratch on the target datasets. Table 1 presents quantitative results, while Figure 2 shows qualitative examples.
Results indicate that models pre-trained on Hypersim-WB consistently outperform those trained solely on real data. The improvement is particularly pronounced for smaller datasets like MIMO (78 images), highlighting the role of synthetic pre-training in enhancing generalization and convergence. Even for larger datasets such as LSMI, pre-trained models maintain superior performance compared to the trained-from-scratch counterparts.
blocks.zh:
对于多发光体估计,我们遵循先前的工作[13],并评价两个有代表性的图像到图像结构:UNet[19]和HDRNet[9]。 每个模型都经过培训,从RGB输入中推断出数据生成管道部分所描述的密集光亮图. 为了进行比较,我们还包括了Gray World(GW)[22]算法和FC 4模型[12],分别代表了统计学和以学习为基础的单发光学方法. 为了评估这些基线,它们的全球光辉预测扩大到地-地-地密集地图的大小。
所有以学习为基础的模型最初都接受Hypersim-WB的培训,然后对现实世界的LSMI[13]和MIMO[2]数据集进行微调. 为了评估预训的效果,我们还从零开始在目标数据集上培训模型. 表1显示的是量化结果,而图2显示的是定性实例。
结果表明,在Hypersim-WB上经过预先培训的模型一贯优于仅接受过真实数据培训的模型。 对MIMO(78幅图像)等较小的数据集来说,这种改进特别明显,突出了合成预训在加强通俗化和趋同方面的作用。 即使像LSMI这样的较大的数据集,经过预训的模型与经过训练的从抽取的对等机保持了优异的性能.

blocks.en:
To better reflect realistic training conditions, we explicitly analyse the impact of synthetic pre-training under progressively reduced amounts of real data, a scenario that commonly arises in multi-illuminant estimation benchmarks.
We perform a dataset reduction study using the MIMO dataset. The training set is progressively reduced to 1/2, 1/4, and 1/8 of its original size, while the test set remains constant. Training follows a cross-fold validation scheme, and the UNet architecture is used, as it was the top-performing model in previous experiments.
We compare models pre-trained on Hypersim-WB with those trained from scratch. Figure 3 shows the average angular error, best-quartile (B-25), worst-quartile (W-25), and 95th percentile values across different dataset cardinalities. As expected, performance degrades with decreasing dataset size, but fine-tuned models consistently outperform their from-scratch counterparts. Notably, pre-trained models exhibit a much slower degradation, demonstrating that synthetic pre-training provides robustness when real data are scarce.
blocks.zh:
为了更好地反映现实的培训条件,我们明确分析在逐步减少实际数据量的情况下合成预训的影响,这种情景通常出现在多发光体估计基准中。
我们利用MIMO数据集进行数据集还原研究。 培训组逐渐减少到原规模的1/2、1/4和1/8,而测试组保持不变。 培训遵循交叉验证计划,使用UNet架构,因为它是以往实验中表现最优的模型.
我们比较Hypersim-WB上预先训练的模型和从零开始训练的模型. 图3显示不同数据集主要部分的平均角差、最等分(B-25)、最等分(W-25)和95%的数值。 正如所预期的那样,随着数据集规模的缩小,性能会下降,但经过微调的模型的性能始终高于从抽取的模型。 值得注意的是,经过预先培训的模型的降解速度要慢得多,这表明,在缺乏实际数据的情况下,合成的预先培训提供了坚固性。

The upper and lower bound represent respectively the mean of the worst quartile (W-25) and best quartile (B-25) results.
The dotted lines correspond to the mean 95th percentile.

blocks.en:
While Hypersim-WB is designed for multi-illuminant estimation with dense maps, it can be repurposed for single-illuminant tasks by averaging the ground-truth illuminant chromaticity over each image. We evaluate Gray World, FC 4 [ 12 ] , and the UNet and HDRNet architectures (averaging their dense predictions to obtain a single RGB illuminant vector).
All models are pre-trained with the same hyperparameters described above and fine-tuned on the ColorChecker dataset [ 11 ] . Quantitative results are reported in Table 2 . While UNet and HDRNet perform suboptimally for single-illuminant estimation, fine-tuned versions still outperform models trained from scratch. For HDRNet, the from-scratch model achieves slightly better W-25 and 95th percentile values, but requires substantially longer training (359 epochs vs. 98 for the fine-tuned model), demonstrating that pre-training accelerates convergence while maintaining comparable performance.
For FC 4 , fine-tuning on Hypersim-WB consistently lowers the angular error compared to training from scratch, confirming that synthetic pre-training improves performance even in single-illuminant estimation.
blocks.zh:
虽然Hypersim-WB的设计是用稠密的地图进行多发光学估计,但可以通过在每个图像上平均地真光亮色度来重新用于单发光学任务. 我们评价了Gray World,FC 4 [12],以及UNet和HDRNet架构(验证其密集的预测以获得单一的RGB光亮矢量).
所有模型都使用上述相同的超参数进行预训,并微调了CollectChecker数据集 [11]. 量化结果见表2。 虽然UNet和HDRNet对单发光学估计的成绩不尽人意,但精细调整的版本仍然优于从头培训的模型。 对HDRNet来说,从抽取模式的W-25和95百分位值稍好一些,但需要长时间的培训(359个世纪对98个微调模式),这表明培训前的训练加快了趋同,同时保持了可比的性能.
对于FC 4,在Hypersim-WB上进行微调,从零开始将角误差与训练相提并论,证实合成预训练即使在单发光子估计中也会提高性能.

blocks.en:
In this work, we address data scarcity in illuminant estimation by proposing a general methodology for deriving dense illuminant supervision from physically based 3D-rendered scenes. By exploiting physically grounded illumination components, the proposed pipeline enables the extraction of pixel-wise illuminant chromaticity maps for supervised single- and multi-illuminant estimation. As a concrete instantiation, we apply it to the Hypersim 3D scene collection to generate large-scale synthetic training data.
Extensive experiments with state-of-the-art architectures, including UNet, HDRNet, and FC 4 , demonstrate that pre-training on the proposed synthetic dataset consistently improves performance when models are fine-tuned on real benchmarks. Gains are observed across datasets and tasks, with particularly strong improvements in multi-illuminant estimation and under limited real-data conditions. Moreover, synthetic pre-training accelerates convergence and enhances model robustness.
These results highlight that physically based synthetic data offer an effective solution to the limitations imposed by scarce real-world annotations in illuminant estimation. Future work includes applying the pipeline to datasets featuring outdoor and more complex lighting conditions, as well as investigating domain adaptation to better transfer learned illuminant representations to real-world images.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们通过提出一种一般方法,从基于物理的3D-增强的场景中得出密集的光亮监督,来解决光亮估计中的数据稀缺问题。 拟议的管道通过利用物理上植入的照明组件,能够提取出像素光度的色相图,用于有监督的单发和多发光度估计。 作为具体的即兴表演,我们把它应用到Hypersim 3D场景收集中,生成大规模合成训练数据.
包括UNet、HDRNet和FC 4在内的最新架构的广泛试验表明,在对模型进行实际基准的微调后,关于拟议合成数据集的预先培训不断提高绩效。 在各种数据集和任务之间观察到了收益,在多发光体估计方面,在有限的实际数据条件下,收益特别大。 此外,合成预训加速了趋同并增强了模型的稳健性.
这些结果突出表明,基于物理的合成数据提供了一种有效办法,来克服缺乏真实世界说明的明晰估计所造成的限制。 今后的工作包括将管道应用于以室外和更复杂的照明条件为特征的数据集,并调查域内适应情况,以便更好地向真实世界的图像传输所学得的光辉表现。
